matched: Historical data for 8 physicochemical parameters (turbidity, NH4, TOC, UV254, COND, pH, river flow) monitored by on-line sensors at intake during 2013-2014 and stored in LIMS DWTP
Microbiological parameters from laboratory assays also considered
Two data preparation criteria: availability of parameters/scheduled monitoring (Drinking Water Regulations, DWTP, ISO 22000) and direct alignment to avoid info loss and missing values
Three datasets: Dataset 1 (time interpolated physicochemical), Dataset 2 (experimental physicochemical), Dataset 3 (augmented with microbiological)
2013 daily measurements did not match recording times; linear interpolation used to create Dataset 1 (16,333 hourly observations, 7 parameters) to evaluate temporal variations
Mid-2014 intake sensors time-aligned; Dataset 2 contains 346 matched experimental observations (July-Nov 2014, 7 parameters) for validating trends and relationships

Dataset 3 consists of weekly microbiological data for 2014 (52 samples, 6 bacterial indices: Pseudomonas, Enterococcus, E. coli, Total coliforms, Clostridium, Aeromonas) merged with 8 physicochemical/flow parameters (total 14 parameters)
